note: Every NFL row the board published, graded from the stored player game log — not from anyone's memory. Uncurated: it grades everything the board printed.
no_model_note: ⛔ No number here is a model output. Football has no model — three pre-registered specifications were tested and every one lost to a player's own season average — so the 'confidence' these rows are bucketed by is the player's OWN RECORD at that line, and this page measures how that did.
record_from_note: Counting from 2026-09-07. No earlier cards were set aside.
coverage_note: 0 of 0 published rows are graded. 0 are VOID — a rostered player who took no snaps, which is a refund at the book, not a win. 0 could not be settled at all.
over_bias_note: ⚠️ A VOID is a player who did not take a snap. Those are excluded rather than counted, which is what the book does.
join_note: A pick is joined to a game log by player name and a ±1-day window around kickoff. The window is there because the two leagues date a game differently — college logs a kickoff on its UTC date, so a Thursday night game lands on Friday, while the NFL logs the Eastern one — and it is safe because a player has at most one game inside any three-day window.
